speakers.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Thoughtworks
speakers.biographyMd:
Senior Software Developer at Thoughtworks

A developer with 8 years of experience across Italy and abroad, Elena bridges the gap between clean code and clear communication. At Thoughtworks, she balances technical delivery with a mission to debug the "Human Stack." Through the lens of Crucial Conversations and Green Computing, she equips teams to handle high-stakes friction and build a more sustainable digital future.

Code is logical; people are complex. She helps you master both.

talks.title: System Failure: Why Your Tech Stack Can't Fix a Communication Leak
